query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.created_at,
       cp.id as client_profile_id, cp.stage, cp.interviewStatus, cp.backgroundStatus,
       cp.viaStatus, cp.ipipStatus, cp.wowReportStatus
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.userId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Phipson%' OR u.email LIKE '%phipson%'
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC;
